name: VR Vision Tracking
summary:
Vision Training VR is a focused, distraction-free tool for eye-movement training in virtual reality. A clear 3D target moves through guided routines while you follow it with your eyes — helping you practice smooth pursuit, saccades, and convergence in a calm, fully immersive space.

Everything is in your hands with a simple in-VR control panel:

• Multiple routines — circular, horizontal, vertical, diagonal, and multi-target saccade patterns.
• Adjustable speed, target size, and range of motion.
